items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 85:1
items.html: It was explained above in Answer 7 that only ZA and Ima can use the male MAN of the Dikna, being from the aspect of the upper nine of the direct light, in which, from the measure of the first restriction, there is no femininity in the upper nine, but only in Malchut alone. Therefore the aspect of femininity in them is only the aspect of inclusion from Malchut, called Benjamin included in Joseph, like the MAN of the Dikna. But the Nukva Rachel, who is the aspect of Malchut itself, cannot receive these male MAN of the Dikna, but she needs the Malchut of the first restriction, which is hidden in RADLA, until the future. Therefore Rachel cannot ascend with ZA as MAN to the GAR of Atik, for her MAN of the first restriction, which she needs, is not revealed there.

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XV, List of Answers on Topics 85:2
items.html: (To the question) And therefore only ZA and Leah, who are the aspect of the upper nine of the direct light, can be included in the Ibur of YESHSUT that is in the place of the GAR of Atik, and clothe the GAR of AA, for they have there the aspect of the MAN of the first restriction that suffices for them, namely from the aspect of the Yesod of Malchut that is in the Dikna. Therefore they ascend at Shabbat Mincha and clothe the place of the GAR of AA. But Rachel cannot ascend with them, for she has no aspect of her own MAN there, which is the Malchut of the first restriction, for it is hidden in RADLA and does not come into a coupling until the future. And see well in Answer 7.
